done_so_far: New Next.js 16 app at ../seo-dashboard (App Router, TS, Tailwind v4, no src-dir, @/* alias, --disable-git so no .git created). lucide-react added. dev/start scripts pinned to port 3100 (was free).

app/globals.css: design-dna §3 token table as CSS custom properties on :root/[data-theme=dark] + prefers-color-scheme fallback; @theme inline maps to Tailwind utilities (bg-card, text-secondary, rounded-card, shadow-popover, tabular-nums via Tailwind core). Renamed --text-primary -> Tailwind color 'foreground' and kept --primary -> 'primary' to avoid a utility-name collision (documented in the CSS).

No-flash theming: next/script beforeInteractive inline script + ThemeToggle (Light/Dark/System) in components/ui/theme-toggle.tsx, lib/theme.ts shared constant/resolver, live-swap verified via Playwright click, System listens to matchMedia changes.

App shell: components/shell/{sidebar,topbar,app-shell,nav-config,search-input,help-item}.tsx. Sidebar: brand block, search input with working '/' focus shortcut routing to /pages?q=, nav sections (Essentials/Crawl data) with real Runs badge, active=bordered pill, bottom Appearance/Help (clipboard-copy of the real POC-1-REPORT.md path, not a fake link)/user row. Topbar: route title table + lib/topbar-actions-context.tsx extensible right-slot for S9/S10. <1024px: icon rail + SlideOver nav drawer.
components/ui/slide-over.tsx: hand-rolled focus trap (no deps) + Esc + 50% scrim + createPortal to body; reused for both the future command-builder and the mobile nav drawer.

lib/data.ts: listRuns/getRun/getPages(status,rendered,q,sort,dir,limit,offset)/getPage/rawHtmlPath/getBench/resolveRunId/getReportPath. Verified on-disk shapes against src/storage/runStore.ts and scripts/bench.ts source directly (not guessed). Module-Map cache per runId. Defensive: readdir/JSON.parse failures caught, console.warn with a count, never throws — confirmed live (1 malformed run dir produced exactly one console.warn).

lib/types.ts: duplicated read-side copy of src/models/types.ts (header comment names the source of truth) — chose this over a cross-project relative type-only import for Next/Turbopack build robustness.

components/ui/{button,card,chip,badge,delta-pill,stat-value,skeleton,empty-state,table}.tsx — tokens only, zero raw hex, DeltaPill is icon+text (never color alone), Table has aria-sort + sticky header + 44px rows.

Route skeletons: app/{page,runs/page,pages/page,pages/[id]/page,failures/page,sitemap/page}.tsx — each one file, real data-layer calls, honest EmptyStates (no-runs shows the actual `npm run crawl --` command; Failures distinguishes 'no runs' from 'run is clean').

npm run build: clean compile + typecheck (one benign Turbopack output-tracing warning on the intentional CRAWLER_STORAGE_DIR dynamic path, documented inline, harmless for this non-deployed local POC).

Playwright verification (dev server on 3100, stopped before returning): 0 console errors/warnings across the whole session; light+dark incl. live toggle; 1440 / 1023 (icon-rail breakpoint) / 390 widths; no page-level horizontal scroll at 390 (confirmed via scrollWidth===clientWidth); Pages table horizontal overflow correctly scoped to its own card; mobile nav drawer opens, Esc closes it, focus restored to the trigger button (confirmed in the a11y snapshot); Inter font confirmed self-hosted (200 on the woff2, computed font-family includes Inter + the auto-generated 'Inter Fallback'); ran 2 real crawls (smoke-example, smoke-books) plus exercised ~24 pre-existing real runs from other slices (target-full, target-robots, redirect-loop, quotes-js, ...) through every route including a real seeded target-site page-detail and a real robots.txt/sitemap cross-ref render.

Screenshots saved to sprints/breadcrumbs/s8-screens/ (12 files: overview light/dark, runs, pages list w/150 real rows, page detail, failures w/ real 404s+blocked, sitemap w/ real robots.txt content, 1024 icon-rail, mobile nav drawer, 390 overview + pages table).

Fixed a real bug found during this pass (not just typecheck): getPages' sort comparator indexed depth/responseTimeMs as top-level CrawledPage fields when they are nested under crawl.depth/performance.responseTimeMs — replaced with an explicit sortValue() switch.
